name: Merge
description: Merge two DataFrames with pandas merge semantics, including anti-join (rows in the left frame with no match on the right).
usage: ``using`` names the left DataFrame; the remaining DataFrame in the pipeline is the right side. Provide either ``on`` (a key present in both frames) OR both ``left_on`` and ``right_on`` (differently-named keys). ``how`` selects the join type — ``inner`` (default), ``left``, ``right``, ``outer`` or ``anti``. ``suffixes`` disambiguates overlapping column names.

attributes.name: on
attributes.description: Column(s) to join on, present in both DataFrames. Mutually exclusive with ``left_on``/``right_on``.

attributes.name: how
attributes.description: Join type, mapped to pandas merge ``how``: ``inner`` (default), ``left``, ``right``, ``outer``, or ``anti`` (keep only left rows with no right match).

attributes.name: left_on
attributes.description: Column(s) from the left DataFrame. Use together with ``right_on`` instead of ``on`` when the keys are named differently.

attributes.name: right_on
attributes.description: Column(s) from the right DataFrame. Use together with ``left_on`` instead of ``on`` when the keys are named differently.

attributes.name: suffixes
attributes.description: Two suffixes appended to overlapping column names from the left and right frames respectively. Default ``["_x", "_y"]``.

attributes.name: using
attributes.description: Name of the left DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. The right DataFrame is the other frame remaining in the pipeline.

json_schema.title: Merge

on.description: Join key column(s) present in both frames.

how.description: Join type, mapped to pandas merge ``how``: ``inner`` (default), ``left``, ``right``, ``outer``, or ``anti`` (keep only left rows with no right match).

using.description: Name of the left DataFrame key in the pipeline data dictionary. The right DataFrame is the other frame remaining in the pipeline.

json_schema.description: Merge the left DataFrame (``using``) with the remaining DataFrame on ``on`` or ``left_on``/``right_on``.

columnRef.description: A single column name or a list of column names.
